releaseNotesSummary: Unsigned pre-1.0 performance and scan-throughput release. v0.1.0-pre.40 builds on the v0.1.0-pre.39 large-ACL conflict hotfix by adding findings-classification progress and hot-path optimization for scans with hundreds of thousands of item/ACL rows. Findings classification now caches repeated broken/missing SID checks, avoids expensive path splitting for path-component policy checks, preserves the same findings.csv schema, and prints throttled progress during item, ACL, SID, service-account, and completion phases. This release also adds opt-in target-level parallel collection for multi-target Invoke-ShareSurferScan -TargetPath runs through -ParallelTargetCollection and -TargetCollectionThrottle, using PowerShell 5.1-compatible runspaces while keeping default scans sequential. The package includes the built PowerShell module files, startup launcher, diagnostic scripts, documentation, hashes, release manifest, dependency-age report, and prebuilt standalone dashboard template assets.
